# Beben Design

> Beben Design is a one-person, design-led digital product studio in Westlands, Nairobi. Luis Howin Maina researches, designs and builds every project himself. Websites and brand identities start at $250 USD; product and UX design is quoted after a discovery call. Fixed prices, 20 business days as standard, no hourly billing.

I work with businesses and founders who need a clear, fast site and a brand that matches how they run. Every engagement is direct: the person you brief is the person who does the work. There are no account managers and no handoffs. The site publishes its own measurements at https://beben.design/#demo.

## Services

- [Websites](https://beben.design/services/#websites): From $250 USD. Design and build of a fast, responsive website, domain and Google Workspace email setup, foundational SEO, and foundational branding. 20 business days, or a 10-business-day sprint for +$100.
- [Brand identity](https://beben.design/services/#brand-identity): From $250 USD. Logo, colours, typography, voice, print and clothing applications, and a brand guide, from zero or a rework. 20 business days.
- [Product and UX design](https://beben.design/services/#product-ux): Quoted after a discovery call. Research, wireframes and prototypes, usability testing, UI design and component libraries, accessibility checks, and developer handoff.
- [How I work](https://beben.design/#process): Four stages, one person: Research, Structure, Visual, Build.

## Work

- [Work](https://beben.design/work/): Client projects with a brief and a result. Neopolaris, Nanyuki Country Home and Frontier Moto, each live at its own address.

## Labs

- [Labs](https://beben.design/labs/): Free browser tools, offline-first apps and hardware experiments. No accounts, no uploads, no server calls, no data collection. Every free tool is downloadable as a standalone HTML file that runs offline forever.
- [QR Code Generator](https://beben.design/qr-code-generator/): Make unlimited free QR codes with custom colors, patterns, frames, and logos. No sign-up, no watermark.
- [EXIF Viewer and Stripper](https://beben.design/exif-stripper/): See the GPS coordinates, camera serial, and timestamps hidden in a photo, then download a clean copy.
- [Checksum Verifier](https://beben.design/checksum-verifier/): Hash a downloaded file with SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, or SHA-512 and compare it to the published value.
- [Text Diff](https://beben.design/text-diff/): Compare two revisions of a contract or a copy deck side by side, without uploading either one.
- [Contrast Grid](https://beben.design/contrast-grid/): Paste a whole palette, get every foreground and background pair scored against WCAG AA and AAA at once.
- [Dither Machine](https://beben.design/dither-machine/): Drop an image and push it through Atkinson, Floyd-Steinberg, or ordered Bayer dithering. Export the PNG.
- [Does It Fit?](https://beben.design/character-counter/): One text box, checked live against every limit that matters: title tags, meta descriptions, posts, subject lines.
- [Beben Arcade](https://beben.design/games/): Twenty-three tiny 8-bit games at one address. Add it to your home screen, play offline, beat your best. No ads, ever.
- [Corpus](https://beben.design/codex/): A small library you can carry: thirteen subjects in portable files, answers in milliseconds, no server needed. Formerly Codex, now v2.0.
- [Essential Watch](https://beben.design/essential-watch/): A calm, repairable wrist instrument between the Casio F-91W and the Apple Watch Ultra. Spec v6 in the open, with a live emulator.
- [Rev Log](https://beben.design/rev-log/): An open source telemetry system for motorcycles: lean, throttle, braking and revs captured on the bike, visualised in the browser, owned by the rider.
- In development: JWT Decoder, Passphrase Generator, Colour Blindness Simulator, SVG Cleaner, Favicon Forge, Fluid Type Calculator, Invoice Builder, Freelance Rate Calculator, Screenshot Framer, Barcode Generator.

## Company

- [About](https://beben.design/about/): Luis Howin Maina, owner, lead designer and builder. A one-person studio in Westlands, Nairobi.
- [Contact](https://beben.design/contact/): Tell me what you're building. A few lines is enough. Reply within one working day. Direct email, phone and WhatsApp.
